## Part 1 · 00:00

[00:00] You say you want to go on the bike? One of the best things I ever did was put matching sunglasses on myself and on my dog and take him for a ride on my bike. I go out every day and watch people rush out of their homes to take photos. I get more attention than the presidential motorcade. Cars get friendly, honk, strangers wave at me, give me the thumbs up, women call out, "How cute!" and I call back, "So is the dog." This is how I get so many of my video interviews because of my dog. He's irresistible bait when I go fishing for men.

[00:33] So get yourself a dog, get some matching sunglasses, drill holes in the sunglasses, put elastic under his chin and behind his head, and away you go. You don't need a bike, just go for a walk with him in a park and watch how strangers come up to you and want to chat. Get some of our dog trivia and training tracks and give them out, or take the time to share the gospel verbally. Just ask them if they think there's an afterlife. You can get the tracks at livingwaters.com.
